user_constraint: 動くのに必要な最小限の構成から広げる。既製品は非常停止周りを指す。回路製作設備なし。計算機は車載LinuxミニPC。Raspberry Pi 5に限定しない。非常停止はDC定格が合うスイッチでの直接遮断を第一候補とする。
CAD_scope: E4 after two independent reviews. Centered25-hole deck and peripheral low heads; cargo stops optional; switch mounting/terminal envelopes and cable tie bridges. Actual electrical hardware and wiring qualification pending.
notes: User-proposed assembled Pico RS485 HAT is the selected architecture. Do not also purchase USB-RS485 or a bare transceiver. Main power and E-stop have different functions.
No custom PCB, user soldering, industrial safety relay or comprehensive robot power controller is required by default.
Conditional compatibility checks are not automatic purchase requirements. Do not claim battery or regeneration compatibility without evidence.
No additional mechanical brake. Removing motor power removes drive torque and may allow coasting; stationary holding on slopes is outside the existing flat-floor scope.

E3 includes revised packaging, functional wiring and software behavior. It is not a purchase/production release: PC supply, cable terminations, board stack, battery protection and motor-input transients remain to qualify.
baseline_goal: 手動指令で前後進・旋回・通常停止を行い、非常停止で左右モーターの給電を物理的に切る。
baseline_communication: Onboard Linux mini PC -> USB CDC -> user-owned Pico -> Pico-2CH-RS485-compatible assembled board -> CH0 left motor / CH1 right motor. No additional USB-RS485 converter.
baseline_power: Battery -> source fuse -> main switch -> branches: left fuse -> E-stop NC1 -> left motor; right fuse -> E-stop NC2 -> right motor; computer fuse -> suitable computer supply -> Linux computer -> USB Pico/HAT. Common power return. E-stop cuts motors only; main switch cuts all branches.
optional_or_conditional: One relay and its coil supply if direct E-stop DC switching is unsuitable
Additional battery protection only after assessing the battery/adapter protection already present
Regeneration absorption only if motor/power-source compatibility requires it; no custom clamp circuit selected
Cable assembly service only if available cables cannot meet the wiring specification
electrical_compatibility_checks: E-stop/contact DC voltage, breaking current and motor-input inrush; AC or thermal ratings alone are insufficient
Source fuse and wire/connector current capability; do not inherit the old five-fuse layout without justification
Battery/adapter protection and motor bus voltage during braking and power interruption
Motor behavior after power restoration and communication loss; verify with selected protocol/software, without assuming an independent hardware guarantee

baseline_computer.power_requirement: Match the selected computer input range to battery voltage over charge/discharge. Add an assembled DC/DC only if needed; no universal 5 V supply or Pi-specific RAM/USB requirement is imposed.

stopping_behavior.normal_stop: Powered velocity control: reduce commanded speed toward zero. Tune and verify response on actual motors.
stopping_behavior.direct_power_cut: Removes the drive supply. Do not credit commanded electrical braking or standstill holding after supply removal; stopping distance remains unmeasured.
stopping_behavior.brake_then_disconnect: Not implemented by a simple direct power switch. Requires a separate controlled sequence if later requested; not added to the baseline.

pico_interface.product_match_basis: User reports the photograph matches; exact delivered circuit revision unverified
pico_interface.power: USB from Linux computer only; no battery connection to Pico/RS485 signal pins

estop.contacts: 2NC, one independently switched positive supply per motor
estop.connection: M3.5 screw terminals, completed crimp leads or permitted bare-wire connection per manufacturer instructions
estop.shipping_destination_basis: Yahoo page default Tokyo, actual address/Prime unverified

main_switch.purpose: normal all-load disconnection after Linux shutdown; E-stop is separate

power_budget.qualification: Fuse curves, motor inrush and actual wire/connector ratings determine final values; no claim that 3A fuse opens at3A or that motor current limits suppress inrush.

software_design.loss_response: Pico requests zero speed and inhibits drive commands after host timeout or motor-response fault; new run command required after recovery
software_design.power_reset_observability: No separate E-stop sensing contact: loss of replies detects sustained supply interruption, not every short interruption. No hardware restart-prevention claim.
software_design.normal_stop: ramp speed command toward zero while powered
software_design.electrical_brake: 0x64 DATA[7]=0xFF in velocity mode, test before use
software_design.pico_failure: No external watchdog/cutoff path; physical E-stop remains independent of software
software_design.stale_commands: Discard queued USB/motor commands after stop, startup and any fault; do not replay the last nonzero target
software_design.both_wheels: Either motor communication/driver fault inhibits both wheel commands
software_design.reconnect: Reconnect both motors with zero commands; require a fresh explicit RUN action
software_design.estop_recovery_operator: Cancel RUN at Linux PC before releasing E-stop; missing short power interruptions remains an unresolved limitation
